xmldoc.short_description: Wait for timer objects to stop.

param_input_item.param_description: Timer object or timer object array.

description.p: wait blocks until each timer in t stops. While it is waiting, Nelson continues processing timer callbacks so scheduled callbacks can complete.
Use wait in scripts and tests when later commands depend on timer callbacks having completed.

example_item.example_item_description: Wait until a repeated timer finishes all requested tasks.
